newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Alcan rises in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Alcan rises in New York.

text.p: Canada's Alcan Aluminium Ltd rose slightly on Thursday to highlight trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) and foreign shares.

Traders said markets in ADRs were quiet ahead of the release of producer price index (PPI) data due out at 0830 EDT/1230 GMT Friday. The data are an indicator of inflation and could help convince the U.S. central bank to raise interest rates.
"It looks like the pre-PPI syndrome -- it's very, very quiet, and no business," a trader said. "I think people are tidying up a bit before tomorrow."

Shares in Alcan rose 1/8 to 31-3/8 ahead of the release of the company's first quarter earnings, expected on Thursday. Trade was heavy, with almost three time the normal daily volume before midday, and Alcan was the most-active foreign share in New York.
Among European ADRs, Britain's Glaxo Wellcome Plc rose 3/8 to 35-7/8 after promising trial results were released on the company's hepatitis B drug, Lamivudine.
Brazilian telephone company Telebras fell 3/4 to 114-5/8. The company Thursday reported consolidated net income of 279 million reais for January.
Argentine bank ADRs were weighed by fears of rising interest rates in the United States. Argentina's Banco de Galicia fell 49/64 to 22-5/8 and Banco Frances fell one to 27.
Decliners led advancers 263 to 194 among 806 ADRs. The ADR index was down 0.17 percent and volume at midday was 28 million shares.
